name: human-friendly-diff
description: Turn a working-tree diff into an intent-grouped local HTML review.

interface.shortDescription: Review working-tree changes grouped by intent.
interface.longDescription: Captures the exact Git working-tree diff, lets the active agent explain and group hunks by implementation intent, and renders a self-contained local HTML review.
defaultPrompt: Generate a human-friendly diff for this working tree.
Group my current changes by implementation intent.
